verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data, such as store, order, or domain-portfolio analytics. Natural-language domain-name suggestions are keyword-driven search, not insights from user data. The MCP server and the gddy agent skill let external AI assistants call GoDaddy; they are not insights produced inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
